name: Gemma 4 LiteRT Wiki
description:
Gemma 4 LiteRT Wiki — a local AI Wiki running inside Obsidian. Powered by Gemma + LiteRT-LM / WebGPU. No Ollama, no API key, no subscription, no server, and your notes never leave your device.

Turn your notes into a continuously maintainable Wiki with Ingest / Scan: cross-note connections, concept pages, tags, links, and deterministic Sources. Ground AI on a single note, multiple notes, or the entire Wiki. Includes Quiz, Flashcards, Find Gaps, and custom Skills.

Your original notes are never modified. Every write goes through a full preview first. Sources are generated deterministically by the plugin, with staleness detection, Provenance checks, and contradiction scanning. The Wiki stays pure Markdown, with no database lock-in.

Local. Reviewable. Traceable. Your Wiki, your notes.
author: itsyuimorii
